title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck

recommendations.recommendation: Choose carefully what to care about, because attention and energy are limited.
recommendations.rationale: Everyone cares about something, so the real choice is what is worth the cost.
recommendations.argued_against: Caring about everything or trivial things

recommendations.recommendation: Accept that life involves constant problems and look for problems you enjoy solving.
recommendations.rationale: Happiness comes from solving problems, not from avoiding them; avoiding them creates more suffering.

recommendations.recommendation: Stop trying to feel good all the time and accept negative emotions as normal.
recommendations.rationale: Chasing positivity constantly is itself a source of misery; pain is a useful signal.

recommendations.recommendation: Take responsibility for everything that happens to you, even when it is not your fault.
recommendations.rationale: Fault and responsibility differ; only responsibility gives you power to respond.

recommendations.recommendation: Be willing to be wrong and test your beliefs about yourself and the world.
recommendations.rationale: Certainty blocks growth; doubt and error drive improvement.

recommendations.recommendation: Choose good values: those based on things you control, such as honesty, curiosity, and humility.
recommendations.rationale: Bad values depend on external outcomes, such as pleasure or popularity, and cause suffering.
recommendations.argued_against: Values like constant pleasure, material success, or always being right

recommendations.recommendation: Learn to say no and set boundaries in relationships.
recommendations.rationale: Healthy relationships need mutual respect for limits and refusal of unhealthy dynamics.

recommendations.recommendation: Commit to people, projects, and choices rather than keeping every option open.
recommendations.rationale: Freedom without commitment is shallow; meaning comes from giving up some options.

recommendations.recommendation: Act first and let motivation follow, instead of waiting to feel inspired.
recommendations.rationale: Action produces inspiration, which then produces more action.

recommendations.recommendation: Think about your own mortality to put your concerns in perspective.
recommendations.rationale: Facing death clarifies what actually matters and reduces fear of trivial things.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not see yourself as exceptional; accept being ordinary and work on mundane tasks.
recommendations.rationale: Entitlement and delusions of special status make people avoid effort and live in fantasy.
recommendations.argued_against: Entitlement and the belief that one is special
